🐚 ELI5 Kata · Program Verification #2: Fibonacci (Coq, 6 kyu)

Naive fib(n) branches into 2^n calls, while fib2(n) = fib_aux 0 1 n walks in O(n) with a 2-number sliding window. How do we prove fib2 n = fib n?

https://github.com/8b-is/space-bender/tree/main/katas/6kyu/fibonacci-verification

🪟 ELI5 Step 1 (Why Direct Induction Gets Stuck):

If you induct directly on fib_aux 0 1 n, the very first step changes (0, 1) into (1, 1), then (1, 2), then (2, 3)!
Your induction hypothesis only knows about (0, 1), so it can't match (1, 1).

🔑 ELI5 Step 2 (The Sliding Window Invariant):

Generalize the window to ANY adjacent Fibonacci pair (fib k, fib (S k)):
`fib_aux (fib k) (fib (S k)) n = fib (n + k)`!
One step shifts `(fib k, fib (S k))` to `(fib (S k), fib (S (S k)))` — matching `IHn (S k)`!

✅ Plugging in k = 0 gives fib_aux (fib 0) (fib 1) n = fib (n + 0) = fib n with 0 axioms!
